prerequisites: good user-level knowledge of UNIX systems, directory hierarchy navigation, creating and editing files (vi, joe), shell programming (sh/bash), commands find, grep, cat, cut, ls, awk.

learning_outcomes.text: The students will know the principles of UNIX system administration.
They will be able to practically carry out the basic duties of a system administrator.

syllabus_topics: access permissions for files and directories, ACL
mounting and unmounting of filesystems to the directory hierarchy (mount, umount, /etc/fstab)
assessment_rules: Approximate grading scale: A 92%, B 84%, C 76%, D 68%, E 60%. The final assessment is based on a preliminary component (40%) and a final component (60%).
bibliography: Course notes provided on the course website, freely available electronic materials
institution: Univerzita Komenského v Bratislave (Comenius University Bratislava)
degree: Bachelor Applied Informatics (1-AIN), Faculty of Mathematics, Physics and Informatics
